policy.provenance: A Karmic Debt finding requires an exact upstream compound value plus a non-empty provenance identifier. A reduced value alone never implies a debt compound.
policy.validation: The supplied reduced value must equal the single-digit reduction of the exact compound; duplicate observations for the same metric are rejected.
policy.scope: The engine detects debt from preserved upstream compounds. It does not reverse-infer 13/4, 14/5, 16/7 or 19/1 from a final 4, 5, 7 or 1.

remaining_before_done: Exact Flutter test SUCCESS must be visible on the tested commit.
Upstream profile/cycle calculators that expose Karmic Debt must preserve and pass their exact compound provenance rather than only final reduced values.
Interpretation content remains separate from this calculation contract.
